name: RimWorld: Open World
author: GrassNotFound
description: Open World multiplayer mod for RimWorld.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update && apt install -y curl jq unzip
R=$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/D12-Dev/OpenWorld/releases/latest)
U=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '.assets[].browser_download_url' | grep -i linux-x64 | head -1)
cd /mnt/server
curl -sSL -o server.zip "$U"
unzip -o server.zip
chmod +x OpenWorldServer
